purpose: Measure causal value of a derived change-capsule for cross-runtime handoff without installing OpenSpec or changing runtime/config.
baseline: Current provider-neutral handoff plus authoritative task/plan sources.
change_under_test: A small DERIVED/DO NOT EDIT capsule containing authoritative refs, observable requirements, non-goals, and exact AC.
outcome: intent recall, invented/contradictory facts, exact AC/next-action correctness, pre-action read/tool calls, and input tokens.

hypotheses.H2: A semantic capsule improves cross-runtime handoff over current handoff and over byte/position-matched padding.
hypotheses.H3: The capsule adds no measurable value beyond the current handoff and formatting/length controls.

cases.exact_ac: uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_tg_bridge.py tests/test_api.py

arms.P: Current handoff brief plus deterministic padding with exactly the same UTF-8 byte length and insertion position as B.
arms.B: Current handoff brief plus the derived semantic capsule at the fixed insertion position.

randomization.order: one deterministic permutation of all 27 case/arm/repetition cells; no parallel fan-out

agent.solution_objects: must be unreachable in the sealed clone

scoring.agreement: Cohen kappa on binary fact-level semantic decisions; disagreement is miss
scoring.stop: kappa < 0.8, missing/aborted run, stale source, edit/side effect, solution object reachable, or leakage

pass_fail.recall_gain_pp: B versus both A and P >= max(20, noise_floor_pp) on at least 2 of 3 cases
pass_fail.reads: B median below both controls by at least 1 and above reads_noise_floor on at least 2 of 3 cases

noise.per_case_metric_range: max-min over the three repetitions for A and P separately
noise.noise_floor: max of A/P recall ranges across cases
noise.reads_noise_floor: max of A/P read-call ranges across cases
noise.median: numeric median; ties retained; no missing-value imputation
